resource_coverage.scope: Verified sampled process-tree RSS and whole-device memory, including startup. Sampling can miss brief peaks; 7 GiB device / 24 GiB RSS guards are not physical RTX5060 limits.

timing_scopes.processing_source_images_per_second: Processing window, excluding model startup; final buffer drain included. Resident and staged windows differ.
timing_scopes.total_job_seconds: Benchmark main through cleanup, including model loading; excludes interpreter/module imports and final report serialization because the timer is sampled before the report writer.
timing_scopes.process_wall_seconds: Isolated process launch through observed exit, including interpreter/module imports, warmup and external monitor polling overhead.
timing_scopes.process_source_images_per_second: Source count divided by process wall. Use zero-warmup blocks for whole-job schedule comparisons.
timing_scopes.per_frame_p95_latency_ms: Separate per-run live replay frame estimates, not pooled percentiles or sustained camera latency.
timing_scopes.buffered_ingestion_p95: Source ingestion plus triggered flushes; excludes final EOF drain and is not completion latency. No completion-latency ratio.

screen_outcomes.scope: Exploratory screens are not repeated speedup claims.

cross_build_reference.scope: Baseline output continuity only; no cross-build timing comparison.

recommendation.archive: Singleton detector/crop1, minimal Hydra, fixed GRU/check1, decode2 with bounded prefetch; measured within-build benefit.
recommendation.live: Singleton minimal/fixed1 with synchronous decode is a qualified warmed-replay candidate; negative-control variation and short clips preclude a universal latency or camera-rate guarantee.
recommendation.limits: RTX5090 exploratory measurements; actual RTX5060/8GiB and sustained live validation remain required.
